cross_modal_consistency.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen evaluates whether current membership or boundaries are represented in the candidate-generation consensus geometry and whether any candidate shows an obvious internal subdivision signal. All seven sets screen at candidate_k=1, meaning the dominant spectral gap sits at the single-cluster resolution; this describes single-cluster dominance and does not constitute evidence of internal multi-cluster substructure. Within-set affinity varies substantially (0.282-0.685), with K8_C0002_M_K8_C0003 notably lower than the others. Nearest-pair between-set affinities are uniformly lower than within-set affinities, with the closest boundaries involving K8_C0004, K8_C0006, and K8_C0008. Overall, the native-view structural pattern is coherent at the partition level for single-cluster representation, but it provides no positive internal-subdivision signal and only triage-level boundary information; it does not establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

All seven sets screen at candidate_k=1, meaning the dominant spectral gap sits at the single-cluster resolution; this describes single-cluster dominance and does not constitute evidence of internal multi-cluster substructure. Within-set affinity varies substantially (0.282-0.685), with K8_C0002_M_K8_C0003 notably lower than the others. Nearest-pair between-set affinities are uniformly lower than within-set affinities, with the closest boundaries involving K8_C0004, K8_C0006, and K8_C0008. Overall, the native-view structural pattern is coherent at the partition level for single-cluster representation, but it provides no positive internal-subdivision signal and only triage-level boundary information; it does not establish biological meaning or clinical validity.
cross_modal_consistency.cross_evidence_context: No prior reports or additional modality-specific native-geometry results are available in this round; the assessment rests solely on the partition structural diagnostics. The nearest-pair affinities identify K8_C0004-K8_C0006 and K8_C0006-K8_C0008 as the closest boundaries for possible pair review, but this is an entry point rather than a merge conclusion.
